status_definitions.VERIFIED_WORKING: Timestamped current evidence verifies this specific module; not automatically the whole system
status_definitions.VERIFIED_FAILED: Newer directly observed failed run, failed receipt or reproducible regression for this specific module
status_definitions.AWAITING_SCHEDULE: Expected production schedule has not arrived; never call this a failure
status_definitions.AWAITING_PUBLISH_CONFIRMATION: Schedule time has passed but new output not verified; never infer a failed workflow
status_definitions.NOT_ENABLED: Formal model or trading authority not enabled, not a defect
status_definitions.STALE: Source old or cache expired, not the same as a code regression
status_definitions.UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED: Missing evidence; do not assert success or failure

required_rules: Read this repository lock before each scan once, including in a new ChatGPT conversation.
Preserve an earlier verified repair baseline until a NEWER explicit contradicting run or deterministic regression test; never silently reclassify it as broken.
A merged code fix does not prove that all future workflows succeeded; report repair status separately from current data readiness.
Different data as-of timestamps can change market outputs; changes must cite input date/version, and same source snapshot plus same model revision must be reproducible.
Missing today's EOD before its scheduled 23:00 Taipei weekday workflow is AWAITING_SCHEDULE, not FAILED.
After scheduled time with no receipt, status is AWAITING_PUBLISH_CONFIRMATION until a current GitHub Actions run proves failure or absence.
V2.2 preferred research mode is NOT_ENABLED for formal selection unless a separate explicit promotion is verified; do not revive Q017.
Do not equate old live/status.json expired cache with proof that all current Fugle quotes are broken.
Never claim a complete new scan if only reading previously stored reports; call it read-only inspection.
Never self-upgrade market data, change trading authority, rebuild vessels, or replace models as part of a reporting-consistency fix.
